summary: Local source/rules audit and 25 passing isolated backend tests cover verification, protected membership, role/ownership checks, stale privileged claims, workflow races and private media. Live deployment/attestation and remaining lifecycle/cost controls prevent production security certification.

findings.issue: Admission and per-call quotas are enforced, but cumulative direct-upload/signup budgets and approved orphan cleanup remain incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Complete upload/signup controls and approved cleanup, then configure live cost alerts. Per-account callable quotas do not bound every resource cost.

findings.issue: Suspension and student deletion are tested; staff responsibility transfer/deletion remains incomplete. Production deletion is intentionally disabled pending approved retention and activation.
findings.recommendation: Complete staff transfer/cleanup and an external deletion route. Use the trusted suspension tool rather than relying solely on Auth-console token expiry. Obtain policy approval before activating production deletion.

findings.issue: The read-only production Firestore request returned SERVICE_DISABLED. Live rules/indexes, App Check, FCM and Crashlytics receipt remain unverified.
findings.recommendation: Execute the reviewed release runbook after explicit billing, regions, deployment and signing authorization; validate live negative-permission and attestation cases.

findings.issue: Exact-domain verified-email admission and email-bound exceptions are implemented. An email domain does not prove student status or authorize institutional processing.
findings.recommendation: Keep roles server-provisioned and exceptions tied to institution-approved references. Confirm controller/publisher, Civora contacts, current campus records and authorization before a live pilot.
